name: Knight of Xoroth: Xorothian Warsteed stays refused inside Molten Core
contract: The Xorothian Warsteed (804703) exception to the no-mount check covers 5-player dungeons only.
Molten Core (map 409) is a raid with instance_template.allowMount = 0, so Spell::CheckCast still
refuses 804703 with SPELL_FAILED_NO_MOUNTS_ALLOWED (83) and the knight stays unmounted.

steps.label: SETUP the knight is in Molten Core
SETUP the knight knows Xorothian Warsteed
The knight tries to summon the Warsteed inside the raid
CONTRACT the raid refuses the Warsteed with SPELL_FAILED_NO_MOUNTS_ALLOWED
CONTRACT the knight stays unmounted inside the raid
